findings.title: Unchecked false/null from file read and JSON decode
findings.description: file_get_contents() may return false and json_decode() may return null, but both are used unchecked (the previous === false check and JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR were dropped), so a missing/invalid file yields 'Trying to access array offset on null' instead of a clear ConfigException.
findings.suggestion: Restore the === false check and JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR (or check json_last_error()).
